title: Weapon Enchantment
body:
Syntax: weapon enchantment <weapon> <flaming|frost|life|sharp|vorpal|shocking>
       weapon enchantment <sword> <fire|water|wind|lightning|earth>

Description: A Bukijutsu shinobi of level 55+ can permanently infuse a carried or wielded sword with one of their personally discovered chakra natures. The chosen element is bound to that INDIVIDUAL sword, persisting through trades, saves and reboots. A Bukijutsu wielder with the SAME unlocked chakra nature gains +50% sword strike damage. This stacks multiplicatively with Samurai Sabre's +20% (together +80%); Earth adds a further +25% raw strike damage. On each successful enchanted hit, elemental chakra can produce the SAME effect and chance as the corresponding elemental jutsu: Fire (Burning, 40%), Water (Drained chakra, 40%), Wind (Off Balance/stamina drain, 40%), Lightning (Paralyzed, 30%), Earth (extra direct damage, no status). Non-Bukijutsu wielders, and Bukijutsu wielders who do not possess the chosen element, get no elemental bonus or effect. Existing non-elemental Ninja Arts properties still function as before. An individual weapon can have only one enchantment. Disenchant first to replace it. Costs 60 Chakra and 20 Stamina; 10-second cooldown.

Level gained: 55
Damage type: Elemental sword strikes (Fire / Water / Wind / Lightning / Earth)
Base damage: +50% physical sword strike (+25% more on Earth), stacks with Samurai Sabre
